text:
Type: slatted wooden bench with shelf
Use: sitting while dressing, holding towels, shoes or baskets on the lower shelf; bathroom, hallway, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, rustic
Materials: solid birch with a clear lacquered finish, slatted seat and shelf, metal bolts
Colors: light natural birch, pale honey
Shape: open frame with a slatted top and a slatted lower shelf, four square legs, visible bolt heads, curved notches in the side rails, light and airy
Feel: fresh, natural, simple, warm
Goes with: white tiles, light wood, green plants, linen towels; Scandinavian or spa-like bathrooms and entryways
